messages:
Samir Patel: Hi team — can someone take a quick look at PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4499|#4499>? It adds caller_id and session_token to the KMS/auth audit envelope and bumps schema_version. Need 2 approvals for compliance.

Tara Li: dropping in to look now. quick Q: are we planning any backfill for older logs or completely additive?

Samir Patel: additive only. new fields emitted when present. no DB migrations. we added schema_version to help parsers.

Elaine Gomez: small naming nit: could we use session_uid instead of session_token for HSM parity? we standardize on _uid in that stack.

Mike Chen: CI showing failures in audit-schema-tests.

Samir Patel: saw that too, looking. test expects exact envelope fields; i'll relax assertions and push a fix.

security-bot: Automated checklist: threat model reviewed? NO. secrets scan: PASSED. compliance: manual approval required from eng-security.

Tara Li: I can do the manual pass after tests are green. if you take Elaine's rename in the same commits, i can approve both.

Samir Patel: will rename session_token -> session_uid and update unit tests. pushing change in ~8m.

ci-bot: Build #19700122: running unit tests...

ci-bot: Build #19700122: unit tests failed (audit-schema-tests) — rerun queued.

Mike Chen: once CI passes i will run a quick smoke on dedicated nodes. nothing fancy, just watch error rates for 15m.

Elaine Gomez: also confirm downstream log parsers ignore unknown fields. if any parser deserializes strictly we need a compatibility note.

Samir Patel: confirmed: parsers tolerate unknown keys. added compatibility note in the PR description.

Tara Li: OK queued for review after green CI. plan to approve and merge in the maintenance window tomorrow 03:30 UTC. @Mike Chen can you cover the post-merge smoke then?

Mike Chen: yep 03:30 UTC works. i'll monitor latency and error spikes for 45m.

Samir Patel: thanks all. i'll ping here when CI goes green.

ci-bot: Build #19700122: Success — all tests passed.

Tara Li: skimmed diff after the rename, lgtm. approving now. :thumbsup:

Mike Chen: LGTM from infra smoke. no regressions observed.

security-bot: Manual review recorded by Tara Li (approver) at 1968002501. Compliance approvals met.

Samir Patel: merging in the 03:30 UTC window as agreed. appreciate the quick turnaround! :tada:
